mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user(username, password_hash, user_type, status, deleted) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, 1, 1, 0)

INSERT INTO patient( user_id, real_name, id_card, gender, birthday, phone, address, emergency_contact, emergency_phone, deleted ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{realName}, #{idCard}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{emergencyContact}, #{emergencyPhone}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = 'PATIENT' AND status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.user_type, u.status, p.id AS patient_id, d.id AS doctor_id, d.department_id AS department_id, d.status AS doctor_status, COALESCE(p.real_name, d.real_name, u.username) AS display_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN patient p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.user_id = u.id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.id
